summary.text: Steve Bennett was elected to the California Assembly in November 2020 and represents the 38th District, which includes the western part of Ventura County.

paragraphs.text: He served on the Ventura City Council from 1993 to 1997 and as a Ventura County Supervisor from 2000 to 2020.
Bennett graduated from Brown University with an honors degree in economics and taught high school economics and American history for over 20 years.
